risk_statement: Consumer workspace conversations may be eligible for model improvement depending on user settings.
existing_control_evidence: Provider documents Data Controls and Temporary Chat; exact account settings not yet inspected
proposed_control: Use approved workspace and data classification; verify settings; prohibit confidential data in unapproved accounts

risk_statement: An agent with connected app actions may perform unintended external actions if instructions or inputs are misinterpreted.
source_or_test_basis: Zapier provider documentation; ZA-02 and ZA-03 planned
existing_control_evidence: Provider documents triggers/actions and test-before-publish workflow
proposed_control: Least-privilege app connections; no high-impact write actions without explicit approval; test in isolated account

risk_statement: Outdated or manipulated knowledge-source content may cause incorrect answers or trigger unsafe behaviour.
source_or_test_basis: Zapier knowledge-source documentation; ZA-01 and ZA-03 planned
existing_control_evidence: Provider documents knowledge sources and synchronization
proposed_control: Assign source owner; version and review source data; test prompt injection; restrict actions

risk_statement: Generated assets may contain unintended similarities
source_or_test_basis: marks or content that require human review before publication.
proposed_control: Provider describes training sources and Content Credentials; this is not a guarantee of non-infringement
residual_risk: Human review; trademark and asset checks; retain prompts and provenance; obtain legal advice for high-stakes commercial use

risk_statement: AI-generated content may be shared without clear disclosure if provenance metadata is absent or stripped during export.
existing_control_evidence: Provider states certain exports automatically apply Content Credentials
proposed_control: Check exported file; apply disclosure policy; retain source asset and generation records

risk_statement: Model and duration choices can materially change credit consumption and may exceed a user's available allowance.
source_or_test_basis: Runway credit and model documentation; RW-05 planned
existing_control_evidence: Provider documents credit balance and per-model cost; user has reported free access
proposed_control: Check cost before each generation; set a credit ceiling; obtain approval before paid usage

risk_statement: Generated video may contain temporal inconsistencies or visual artefacts that are difficult to notice in a thumbnail review.
source_or_test_basis: Runway model/prompt documentation; RW-01 and RW-02 planned
proposed_control: Review full clip frame-by-frame for high-impact use; human approval before publication

risk_statement: Users may treat plausible AI output as verified information or delegate decisions without adequate human review.
source_or_test_basis: NIST AI RMF; OECD AI Principles; planned reliability tests
proposed_control: Define permitted use; require human verification for consequential outputs; maintain escalation and accountability
